title: Broken food seal and leaking package raise a safety concern
facts_text: I verified my account and order. The chicken curry was delivered about an hour ago. Its tamper-evident seal is broken and the container is leaking. I am concerned the food may not be safe, so I have not eaten it. I do not have a photo, but the order and delivery are in my account.
request: Please tell me not to eat it if it may be unsafe, escalate the report to the food-safety team, and refund the affected dish and its tax.

strict.reason: The customer reports a credible food-safety concern and damaged food packaging. Safety advice and escalation are required without a photo, and the timely verified damage report qualifies for the affected-item refund.

exception.reason: The report is timely, so the deadline exception is not needed; all requested actions follow from the verified damage and food-safety concern.
